ns2:course.label: Intermediate French I
ns2:course.description: (FR 103) Continuation of FR 102. Introduces students to a full range of structures to complete their initial study of the grammatical system; emphasizes the development of all four skills and cultural understanding through readings and audiovisual enrichment materials. Online language laboratory and internet assignments required. Students planning to major or minor in French should take FR 133 in lieu of FR 103 Credit is not given for both FR 103 and FR 106 Prerequisite: FR 102 or equivalent, or a placement score showing high school achievement equivalent to FR 102.
